dedupe_keys.name: heavy duty electric fleet depot charging load profiles and substation load integration results nlr 2021 nature energy study

description: This dataset from the National Laboratory of the Rockies, formerly NREL, holds 24-hour depot charging load profiles at 15-minute resolution for heavy-duty electric truck fleets and the results of a substation load integration assessment. The entry on the DOE Open Energy Data Portal, read on 2026-09-26, says the data were produced for the 2021 Nature Energy study by Borlaug and colleagues on heavy-duty truck electrification and the impacts of depot charging on electricity distribution systems, that the code generating the profiles is public on GitHub, and that users should cite the paper. The entry was modified on 21 January 2025 and is published under the laboratory's data licence, free of charge. Caveats: the profiles are modelled for the study's fleets and substations and are a one-off release. Simulation uses are adding truck charging demand to substation loads for capacity planning and distribution network flow studies of transport electrification. Related records: data-smart-ds-synthetic-distribution-models offers synthetic networks to host such loads.
